explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/556 (Bondy–Erdős: R_3(C_n) ≤ 4n − 3): 'Łuczak has shown that R_3(C_n) ≤ (4+o(1))n for all n, and in fact R_3(C_n) ≤ 3n + o(n) for even n.' The Lean statement: ∀ ε > 0, for all large n, Even n → multicolourRamsey (cycleGraph n) 3 ≤ (3 + ε)n, where multicolourRamsey G k is the least N such that every k-edge-colouring of the complete graph on Fin N has a monochromatic copy of G. Faithful.
